info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Application Insights API
info.description: The Customer Application Insights API provides access to detailed information regarding the applications associated with a specific customer. By utilizing the customerId parameter, users can retrieve comprehensive data on application usage, performance metrics, and user engagement. This API is particularly useful for analytics and reporting by organizations looking to optimize their application offerings and enhance customer satisfaction. Developers, business analysts, and product managers commonly leverage this endpoint to inform decision-making and improve customer experiences.

get.summary: Retrieve application details for a specific customer.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the application details associated with a specific customer identified by the customer ID. Use this to get comprehensive information about the customer's application status, submitted documents, and more.
